definition_source: Existing evidence only. This first batch did not connect to the PC or board and did not probe devices.

historical_ext4.partition: mmcblk0p14 (data2), ext4 RW, dual-mounted at /opt and /var/mnt/emmc/freq_rw

measurement_history.note: Posttest after one bounded synthetic write; pretest count was not collected.
Readonly health check; 2166 unchanged from R38 posttest.
New boot; dmesg at 36.16/36.18s had two p14 ext4_mb_generate_buddy errors on groups 25/26. 2168 is 2 above R39; R47 had no count, so the +2 cannot be strictly attributed to that reboot.
Same boot as R48; 2168->2168; 0.53s A/B window is not a stability test. No new EXT4-fs error events in retained dmesg since R48.
RAM-only color5 IO test; no new storage error events after preflight. Not a clean-filesystem certificate.

historical_ext4.mount_warnings_recorded: p13/p14 mounted without journal; p14 also 'mounting unchecked fs' in R48 dmesg.

eight_project_file_backups.status: 8/8 complete as of R44, 7862564 bytes, independently verified on box

system_image_backup.missing_for_future_imaging: OEM board model / official non-flash external rescue boot and backup media instructions (R47). Not requested again by this inventory unless the parent is ready to schedule that maintenance track.

forbidden_now_and_until_explicit_itemize: Active filesystem repair, including fsck write repair and fsck -n as a casual probe
System restore, firmware flash, or unofficial image write
Reboot or power cycle (R48 reboot was historical; this batch authorizes none)
Any write under /opt or the p14 freq_rw mount, including test artifacts, snapshots, JSON, models, logs, packs, or sync-induced metadata updates
Replace or modify production v2.4 models, binary, or run.sh
Any other board write, remount, unmount, service kill/stop, network/firewall/route change, or new listener
Use 8 project-file backups as if they were a system snapshot protecting repair

first_batch_this_delivery.action: Define scope from existing evidence only.

allowed_in_principle_after_a_later_expli: Short COM3 readonly checks of already-used commands (uptime, boot id, mount, errors_count, df, stat of known production paths) with COM3 closed afterwards and no echo/credential persistence.

If a later bounded test is separately authorized: single-process, original assets read-only, all new outputs only on proven tmpfs (/tmp or /dev/shm), no production modification, resource/time boxed, write-side effects of the real entrypoint confirmed absent, existing load/watchdog considered. R50 is the precedent for RAM-only color5 IO, not a standing permit to repeat or expand.
still_blocked_without_new_authorization: Any test that would write snapshots/video/JSON under /opt.
Repeating R50 color5 NPU numeric comparison without a new, distinct, evidence-based hypothesis (the numeric gate already failed).
Full-driver held recording (R36 noted original image_eval loads/warms face even with NO_FACE=1 and writes overlays by default).
future_readonly_board_scope_from_existin.important_results: Must be stored off-board (Windows then official CopyToBox / box), with SHA/CRC, as in R44/R50. Do not keep unique results only on p14.

future_write_requires_confirmed_safety_c: Itemized user/parent authorization naming the exact write, path, and purpose
No /opt or other p14 persistent write unless a reviewed alternative persistent volume or rescue environment is approved
Prefer tmpfs and immediate off-board copy
System-level backup/recovery-media scope is still unsatisfied; do not treat R44 as that condition
Stop on any new ext4 error increment or unexpected write
